answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The jetty of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Work waits on the nectar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round.
